subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: proposed retention exception + throughput onramp

Cc: EdgeBank Security <security@edgebank.com>
Date: 2028-07-22T16:12:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: retention window & capacity request

Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick handoff during our renewal review. As part of EdgeBank's audit schedule for Q4, our auditors will request a 540-day audit-log retention window (up from our current 365d). That change has implications for storage and export windows. We also anticipate a 2x throughput ramp for two weeks during the recertification stress tests.

Two asks to start:
- Can Redwood provide a short plan for how audit-log retention would be extended to 540 days and how we would export a 90-day rolling tranche on demand?
- Can you confirm a capacity onramp path for a temporary 2x throughput (we'd like a cost estimate and any SLA exception needed)?

We need answers by EOD July 25 to align with our audit kickoff. Attached is our SOC 2 evidence intake checklist.

Thanks,
Laura

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Kim <laura.kim@edgebank.com>
Date: 2028-07-23T02:25:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: retention window & capacity request

Evelyn / Laura —

Technical outline below (high level):

1) Retention increase to 540d
   - We can extend the audit-log retention in three ways:
     a) Native retention bump in Redwood retention store (adds ongoing storage delta).
     b) Tier older logs to cold S3 (compressed, encrypted) after 90d; retention metadata remains in Redwood for discovery.
     c) Customer-managed archival snapshot exported monthly to your S3 bucket (recommended for auditors who demand custody).

   - Recommended approach: combination (b) + (c): keep 0-90d hot in Redwood for fast queries and ship daily snapshots to your S3 for 90-540d. This keeps egress predictable and lets us meet auditor pickup requests within 24 hours.

2) 90-day rolling tranche export
   - We can provide a pre-signed S3 export job on demand or schedule daily incremental exports to a folder you control. Delivery SLA: 24 hours for ad-hoc exports, 6 hours if we enable expedited export job (requires short-term burst capacity).

3) 2x throughput onramp (two-week window)
   - Options:
     * Temporary Dedicated Burst (recommended): reserve an extra pool of GPUs for two weeks; predictable latency and no interference.
     * Hosted burst with autoscale policy and a soft SLA exception: faster to enable but may see minor latency variance under cloud pressure.
   - Estimated cost range (rough): Dedicated Burst: +$18k/week; Hosted burst: +$9k/week + potential minor tail-latency credits. Final pricing depends on token throughput profile.

I'll prepare a short runbook (export playbook + retention mapping + scoped S3 manifest) and send it by EOD July 24.

-Karthik
Principal Architect, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: s3-export-playbook-v2.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-24T13:09:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: retention window & capacity request

Laura —

Thanks for the details. Commercial note on the onramp and credits: 

- We can offer a temporary 2x throughput Dedicated Burst for two weeks at $36k (flat fee) and include a one-time 25% credit against the burst fee if you sign the attached short amendment to the Master Services Agreement (MSA) before Aug 5.
- For the retention delta to 540d, incremental storage will be billed monthly; we can cap monthly incremental bill at $6k during the audit quarter with a reconciliation after 90 days if that helps budgeting.
- If you need an SLA exception (expedited export SLA <6 hours), we can include it as a short-term SLA addendum; standard SLAs stay in place outside the test window.

If that looks acceptable I'll drop an amendment draft and a DocuSign link for countersignature. We can also move the deal into HubSpot as DEAL-8742 so your procurement team can track.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Renewal Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
